## Summary

Implements ADR 0137 first-release diagnostic ownership and progressive disclosure: structured related diagnostic targets/context, exact Animation Set missing-slot evidence, repair navigation actions in Problems, compact non-fatal Scene View status, and Hierarchy/Inspector severity summaries. Includes the ManifestEntry optional-name compile fix found by Windows Validation.

## Validation

Run Windows Validation and Visual Validation for the Editor presentation changes.
